## Why

Every map-shaped figure the public surface needs — the dossier
at-a-glance map, locators, map-page and entity-snippet visuals — must
come from **one** renderer, or ownership duplicates/circles and two
implementations drift apart. K6 NEW-3 names it: one build-time figure
kit with deterministic projection, binning, tier-guarded drawing and a
CSP-safe SVG serializer, honest about what it cannot draw. P36.27 lands
the geography half (P36.28 takes graphs/charts/legends); P36.19's
standalone-SVG response policy and P36.26's print figures are its first
consumers.

## What lands

- **`exports/src/exports/figures/`** — the FIG-01a package:
  - `model.py` — typed specs/results/errors: map figure spec, records
    with precision bounds + sensitivity tier, child outlines, not-drawn
    counters, bins. Malformed or contract-violating input is refused,
    never partially rendered (fail-closed).
  - `projection.py` — deterministic projection + viewport fit.
  - `simplify.py` — deterministic geometry simplification with a
    minimum-perimeter floor; byte-identical output for identical input.
  - `binning.py` — the **`static-12px@1`** rule (D-K6-4): 12-px minimum
    separation at 1×; **H3 areas at lower framing zooms, tier-0 points
    only at zoom ≥ 10** when tier/precision permits; the H3 resolution
    chosen is the finest whose cell diameter still honours the record's
    precision bound; tier-3 and infinite-precision records never reach
    drawing — they land in the typed not-drawn counters.
  - `paths.py` — deterministic SVG path emission (stable ordering,
    fixed precision).
  - `lexicon.py` + `tokens.py` — read `web/src/lib/lexicon.json` and
    mirror the design tokens; classes and colour variables resolve
    through the shared vocabulary (`legend.dataHue.token` → the same
    `sigTokenValue` binding) — **no forked palette**, and reserved
    disagreement/provisional semantics stay on their lexicon classes
    (`sig-fig-contested`, never a generic marker).
  - `serialize.py` — the CSP-safe serializer: deterministic attribute
    order; refuses `<script>`, `on*` event attributes, external/fetch
    references and malformed markup.
  - `map_figure.py` — the orchestrator: projection+fit → simplification
    → H3-area or point drawing → jurisdiction + child outlines → child
    links → `<title>`/`<desc>`/`role="img"`/`aria-labelledby`
    accessibility → typed not-drawn counts (`declared_no_point`,
    `located_elsewhere` per jurisdiction, `conflicting`, `tier3`) —
    aggregate metadata only, **no raw record data in the figure**
    (SIG-UI-134).
  - `locator.py` — locator geometry + index-sprite construction.
  - `standalone.py` — the P36.19-compatible standalone document:
    internal styles only, light + dark token variables (print forces
    light), byte-identical across repeated renders.
- **`exports/src/exports/cli.py`** — `sig-exports figure
  map|locator|sprite`: spec JSON in → SVG out (+ optional sorted JSON
  metadata, optional standalone wrap); refusal/malformed-spec exits 4
  with no partial output.
- **`web/src/styles/epistemic.css`** — the `.sig-fig-*` class set
  (areas, points, children incl. uncovered-hatch, outlines, source and
  contested states, locator/sprite structure) bound to the shared
  tokens; semantic marker classes documented.
- **ADR-157** — authored and registered (`ADR_TRIGGERS.csv`, spec_src
  `99a_appF_adr.md` + canonical spec rebuilt, `BL-086`, adr index
  regenerated).

## Tests

- `tests/exports/test_figure_kit.py` (**31**): deterministic
  simplification + minimum perimeter; projection/fit; `static-12px@1`
  binning; H3-area vs point mode at the zoom boundary; tier-0/tier-3
  and infinite-precision guards; every not-drawn counter; child
  outlines + links (uncovered children hatched); locator + sprite;
  serializer CSP legs (script / `on*` / external refs refused,
  `xmlns` permitted); standalone determinism; lexicon/token bindings;
  CLI fixture round-trip.
- `web/tests/unit/figure-classes.test.ts` (**3**): emitted class
  vocabulary ⊆ lexicon/CSS; styled classes each carry a rule; marker
  classes are documented semantic hooks; reserved disagreement hue only
  on the contested class.
